description: The queue rule of openspec queue-and-assign (daemon/src/continuity/queue-view.ts and android/control Queues.kt). Synthetic data, written by hand on 2026-11-23.

cases.name: max-working
cases.description: 2 sessions work, the maximum is 2: both queued tasks wait for them

cases.name: reordered
cases.description: The newest queue.reordered of the agent puts AW-4 first

cases.name: free-slot
cases.description: 1 session works: the first task starts soon, the second waits for 2 sessions

cases.name: gate-and-pause-do-not-count
cases.description: A session at a gate and a paused session do not count

cases.name: one-max
cases.description: AW_MAX_WORKING=1 on the device and 1 session works

cases.name: offline
cases.description: The device is offline by its presence

cases.name: login-ended
cases.description: The sign-in of the agent ended

cases.name: login-ended-more-tasks
cases.description: The sign-in ended, 0 sessions work and 3 tasks wait: each task shows the login, not "2 sessions working"

cases.name: usage-limit
cases.description: The 5-hour window is at 93 %; a window after its reset does not count

cases.name: usage-below-limit
cases.description: A 5-hour window at 90 % does not block

cases.name: disk-full
cases.description: The disk is at the limit of the device

cases.name: no-health
cases.description: No health file and no presence: the defaults (maximum 2), not offline

cases.name: old-health
cases.description: A health file of an older awd has no queue object: maximum 2

cases.name: dependencies
cases.description: A task with an open dependency follows with no position

cases.name: members
cases.description: Not queued: done, archived, no assignee, not created, claimed on the device; a moved task (claim of another device) is queued

cases.name: two-agents
cases.description: Each agent has its own queue, sorted by the agent
